frozen_decisions.lam_phys_schedule: linear ramp from 1e-4 to 1.0 over 100 epochs
frozen_decisions.rationale: Physics residuals at random init are ~10x ground-truth scale. 1e-4 bounds them while FNO learns data fit. Schedule is candidate — will be tuned in Step 3.4 based on cos(dL_data, dL_phys) monitoring.

tuning_protocol.step_3_3: Freeze the above as initial candidate. Do NOT tune.
tuning_protocol.step_3_4: Monitor cos(dL_data, dL_phys). If >0 (reinforce), continue ramp. If <0 (conflict), reduce lam_phys growth rate. If ~0, neutral. Freeze final schedule at Step 3.4 end.
